mapper.select: SELECT ADDRESS_NO AS addressNo, RECIPIENT_NAME AS recipientName, RECIPIENT_PHONE AS recipientPhone, ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, ADDRESS1 AS address1, ADDRESS2 AS address2, ADDRESS_NAME AS addressName, DELIVERY_MESSAGE AS deliveryMessage, IS_DEFAULT AS isDefault, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM OFT_USER_ADDRESS WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_USER_ADDRESS ( USER_NO, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, IS_DEFAULT, ADDRESS_NAME, DELIVERY_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{isDefault}, #{addressName}, #{deliveryMessage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_USER_ADDRESS SET IS_DEFAULT = 'N', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_DEFAULT = 'Y'
